outcomes.text: We will distribute 1,200 winter coats to students at our partner schools this winter.

rationale: Goods distributed and counted go to A2.3 per rule 2.

outcomes.text: Each participating student will receive a backpack filled with grade-level school supplies.

rationale: Students receiving school supplies is rule 2's own A2.3 example.

outcomes.text: The league will provide cleats, shin guards and a uniform to every player at no cost.

rationale: Organization providing goods; given, not stated as had, so A2.3.

outcomes.text: Every student we serve will have a warm winter coat and properly fitting shoes by December.

rationale: Young people stated to have coat and fitting shoes; matches F2.4 include.

outcomes.text: Fewer students in our partner schools will go without the school supplies they need.

rationale: Matches F2.4 include: fewer students going without school supplies.

outcomes.text: Girls in the program will report having enough period products during their last period.

rationale: Enough menstrual materials is an explicit F2.4 include.

outcomes.text: Every participating student will have a working laptop and home internet.

rationale: Devices and internet stay A2.3 either way (rules 2 and 15).

outcomes.text: Participating families will have their basic needs met.

rationale: Basic needs names the F2 area but no specific need (food, housing, income).

outcomes.text: Reduce material hardship among the children we serve.

codebook_issue: Material hardship for children could be F2.4 (child deprivation) or F2 domain-only; no rule decides.
rationale: Material hardship spans food, housing and goods within F2; no specific result named.

outcomes.text: Students will have the soap, deodorant and toothpaste they need each week.

codebook_issue: F2.4 lists clothing, shoes, gear, supplies and menstrual materials but not toiletries or hygiene products.
rationale: Having basic goods needed; toiletries not named in F2.4, so medium.

outcomes.text: Children in our program will no longer go without clothes and shoes that fit.

rationale: Not going without fitting clothes and shoes matches F2.4 definition.

outcomes.text: Students will start the school year with every item on their supply list.

rationale: Students stated to have the school supplies they need.

outcomes.text: Students who receive uniforms and shoes from our clothing closet will miss fewer days of school.

rationale: Receiving clothing is the means; the result is school attendance.

outcomes.text: Free period products will mean no student misses school because of her period.

rationale: Products are the means; outcome is school attendance (F2.4 exclude points to Y1.13).

outcomes.text: With donated equipment, more girls will join the soccer team and stay on it all season.

rationale: Joining and staying on a team is Y2.6; donated equipment is the means.

outcomes.text: Youth who get gear from our equipment drive will sign up for a sport this year.

rationale: Signing up for a sport is joining an activity; gear is the means.

outcomes.text: Kids who receive a bicycle will be more physically active after school.

rationale: Physical activity is Y8.1; receiving a bicycle is the means.

outcomes.text: Girls will take part fully in class during their period.

codebook_issue: Y1.9 (class participation) and Y2.6 (participating fully alongside peers) both fit full class participation.
rationale: Taking part in class is an academic engagement behavior.

outcomes.text: Students who receive new clothes will feel more confident in themselves.

rationale: General self-confidence; clothes are the means.

outcomes.text: Students will feel they fit in at school and are not singled out because of their clothing.

rationale: Feeling accepted and included at school is belonging.

outcomes.text: Families will spend less of their budget on back-to-school clothing and supplies.

rationale: Household budget relief is household financial stability; subject is families.

outcomes.text: Every player on our teams will have the gear they need to play this season.

rationale: Youth stated to have the gear they need to play; F2.4 include.

outcomes.text: Students will have the supplies they need to be ready to learn.

rationale: Having needed supplies is F2.4; 'ready to learn' is purpose, not a separate measured result.

outcomes.text: Students will have properly fitting shoes
Students will attend school more regularly.

rationale: Two results: having fitting shoes (F2.4) and school attendance (Y1.13).

outcomes.text: Children will feel dignity wearing clothes that fit them.

rationale: Dignity is closest to self-worth; fitting clothes is the means.
